en: A sepia-toned historic street view showing an elegant boulevard lined with late-19th/early-20th century townhouses and villas. The buildings feature ornate facades, bay windows, and steep, pointed roofs or towers. A tree-lined sidewalk and a few pedestrians are visible. At the top of the card, printed text identifies the location as Leisnig in Saxony and the specific street as König Albert-Strasse.
